meta.player_source: FPL official API bootstrap (26/27) + frozen 25/26 baseline artifact (data/fpl_prev_baselines_2526.json, element code mapping)
meta.team_strength_source: GoalIQ Dixon-Coles, Understat PL ['2526', '2627'] (sama fit-config kuin /api/predict)
meta.method: xP = appearance + goals + assists + clean sheets + goals conceded + saves + defensive contribution + bonus proxy - cards; formula in src/models/fpl_xp.py, validated with a walk-forward backtest on 2025/26 (scripts/backtest_fpl_xp.py)
meta.caveat: Pre-season: player baselines come from last season's FPL history, and the minutes estimate comes from end-of-season rotation plus FPL availability. It sharpens automatically as 2026/27 gameweeks are played.

data_coverage.promoted_prior_method: Promoted-club players with no Premier League minutes: minutes come from a role prior built on FPL price order (XI slots 1/4/4/2 per position; top p_start 0.72, next two 0.30, rest 0.08) times the FPL availability gate. Rates come from a position prior. data_basis=no_history, minutes_confidence=low, minutes_method=promoted_price_prior.
data_coverage.note: data_basis per player: pl_history = the player's own Premier League history carries at least 50% of the weight; limited_history = thin sample, the position prior dominates; no_history = no Premier League minutes. transfers_known=false means the pre-season bootstrap is last season's, so summer transfers are not visible.

context_layer.note: Phase 1b: promoted-side home opener attack boost, manual overrides (data/fpl_manual_overrides.csv) and World Cup fatigue factors

meta.excluded_note: excluded[] lists FPL players who are not in the projection (availability flag i/s/u/n, or horizon xP below 1.0). The rows exist for search and the player card: in_projection=false, with no xP/xmins/p_start fields. Older clients can ignore the list.
